title: Antineoplastic 4-piperidone-1-phosphonothioates with potential multi-targeted inhibitory properties.
authors: Bekheit, Mohamed S; Panda, Siva S; Kariuki, Benson M; Fayad, Walid; Soliman, Ahmed A F; Farag, Hanaa; Girgis, Adel S
one_liner_zh: 该文为抗癌小分子合成与多靶点抑制活性研究，涉及MDM2/p53等蛋白靶点，但无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: A set of 3,5-bis(ylidene)-4-piperidone-1-phosphonothioates 20a‒l was synthesized in high yields through dehydrochlorination reaction of 3,5-bis(ylidene)-4-piperidones 18a‒l and diethyl chlorothiophosphate 19 in DMF containing quantitative amounts of TEA at 0  degrees C. Most of the synthesized agents exhibit effective antiproliferation properties against a variety of cancer cell lines (MCF7/breast, HCT116/colon, and A431/skin), outperforming the efficacy of the clinically approved drugs. Compound 20c (R = 3-ClC(6)H(4)) is the most effective analog discovered with a sub-micromolar activity against MCF7 (IC(50) = 0.650, 3.15 and 3.97 microM, for 20c, 5-fluorouracil, and sunitinib, respectively) as well as remarkable efficacy against HCT116, and A431 (IC(50) = 1.445 and 2.920 microM respectively for 20c, compared to 20.43 and 23.44 microM respectively for 5-fluorouracil). The synthesized analogs demonstrating considerable anti-MCF7 properties were evaluated for their biochemical properties against MDM2, p53, and topoisomerase I/II. Compound 20k [R = 3,4,5-(MeO)(3)C(6)H(2)] is the most effective anti-MDM2 agent with a potency higher than the standard reference (% inhibition of 65.3, for 20k, and 42.2 for doxorubicin; i.e. 1.55-fold). Biochemical activation of p53 by the synthesized analogs is consistent with the anti-MDM2 properties. Compound 20i (R = 4-MeOC(6)H(4)) is the most effective topo-I and topo-IIalpha inhibitor with potency close to that of the standard references (Dxd, and etoposide). Some of the synthesized agents showed selectivity for topo-IIalpha over topo-I. Molecular docking results (PDB: 4OAS) are consistent with the observed properties against MDM2. Based on the biological and biochemical findings, some of the synthesized compounds could serve as promising multi-targeted inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 通过3,5-双(亚基)-4-哌啶酮18a‒l与二乙基氯硫代磷酸酯19在含定量TEA的DMF中、0°C下进行脱氯化氢反应，高收率合成了一系列3,5-双(亚基)-4-哌啶酮-1-硫代膦酸酯20a‒l。大多数合成的化合物对多种癌细胞系（MCF7/乳腺癌、HCT116/结肠癌和A431/皮肤癌）表现出有效的抗增殖特性，其效果优于临床批准药物。化合物20c（R = 3-ClC(6)H(4)）是发现的最有效类似物，对MCF7具有亚微摩尔活性（20c、5-氟尿嘧啶和舒尼替尼的IC(50)分别为0.650、3.15和3.97微摩尔），并对HCT116和A431表现出显著疗效（20c的IC(50)分别为1.445和2.920微摩尔，而5-氟尿嘧啶分别为20.43和23.44微摩尔）。对表现出显著抗MCF7特性的合成类似物，评估了其对MDM2、p53和拓扑异构酶I/II的生化特性。化合物20k [R = 3,4,5-(MeO)(3)C(6)H(2)]是最有效的抗MDM2药物，其效力高于标准参考（20k的抑制率为65.3%，多柔比星为42.2%；即1.55倍）。合成类似物对p53的生化激活与其抗MDM2特性一致。化合物20i（R = 4-MeOC(6)H(4)）是最有效的topo-I和topo-IIα抑制剂，其效力接近标准参考（Dxd和依托泊苷）。部分合成化合物对topo-IIα的选择性高于topo-I。分子对接结果（PDB: 4OAS）与观察到的抗MDM2特性一致。基于生物学和生化研究结果，部分合成化合物可作为有前景的多靶点抑制剂。
